Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: The preacher lists the wood by which God has saved: Noah's ark, Abraham's tree, Isaac's ram, Jacob's rods and staff, the Ark of Moses and David, and finally the cross. The Ark is given many names, and the saints' arks are defended through Christ's words on his true family, the staff of Jacob, and Moses' rod against Pharaoh's sorcerers. The chapter ends on Hebrews 11, the curse of the Law, and Mark 16:16.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፬ is 100 + 4. ካዕበ 'again' and በእንተ 'concerning' (taking the construct) are the usual formulas. ወነገረ is 'and the matter of' (ወ- + construct of ነገር); the printed form could also be read as a verb, but a noun fits. ዕልዋን I take as a plural of ዕሉው 'perverse, crooked' (?): 'the case of the perverse ones'. sentences.l: and-concerning ark-indeed he-saved-him to-Noah by-ark;
sentences.i: And concerning the Ark: He saved Noah by an ark;
sentences.n: The chapter opens with a list of 'wood' by which God saved people, building to the Ark and the cross. Here the first is Noah's ark (Genesis 6–8): ታቦት is the same word as for the Ark of the Covenant, which is the point of the wordplay. ታቦትሰ: the enclitic -ሰ gives 'as for the ark'. አድኀኖ ለኖኅ: the verb carries the suffix -ኦ 'him', doubled by ለኖኅ 'Noah' (the house habit of ለ- marking the object after an anticipating suffix). God is the unstated subject. A pattern to watch through the list: 'He saved/spoke/enriched X by wood'.

sentences.n: Allusion to Genesis 47:31 as the Greek Old Testament and Hebrews 11:21 give it: Jacob 'bowed upon the top of his staff'. The author reads the scene so that the staff itself is honoured (see unit 25). ከተማ here cannot be the usual 'city'; since ከተመ means 'to seal, close, end', I take ከተማ as 'tip, top, end' (?). በትሩ ለያዕቆብ: the suffix on 'his staff' anticipates 'of Jacob' (ለ- naming the owner). ተባረከ: passive-reflexive 'was blessed'. Note that Genesis and Hebrews make Jacob the one who blesses and bows; the source puts Joseph in the scene, and I keep it as printed.

sentences.i: And to Moses also He said: 'Make an ark of wood that does not rot, in the likeness of Zion, an ark of the covenant';
sentences.n: Exodus 25:10, 25:40 (make it after the pattern shown on the mountain). ወለሙሴኒ: 'and to Moses also' (-ኒ). ይቤሎ: 3ms of the defective ብህለ, 'he said to him'. ግበር: 2ms imperative. በአምሳሊሃ ለጽዮን 'in her likeness, of Zion': the suffix -ሃ anticipates the owner ለጽዮን. The theology to note: the earthly Ark is a copy of heavenly Zion, which the Ethiopian Zion/Ark idea turns on. ታቦተ ኪዳን 'ark of covenant' is a second, appositive accusative.

sentences.n: እስመ 'for'. ረሰያ ለታቦት መድኀኒተ: 'he made her, the Ark, a saviour': ረሰየ takes two accusatives (object, then predicate መድኀኒተ), and ለታቦት repeats the object after the suffix. እምትካት is an old uncertain item: the house entry has 'from the foundation, from of old (?)', but in this chapter (here and in unit 10) the sense 'in turn, in exchange, in its place' (cf. ተካ 'replace') fits better, so I read it 'in turn (?)', leave ትካት as printed in l, and flag it for the glosser (the entry አምትካት needs broadening). ተገብረ: 3ms passive 'was done'; the subject is the pair ተኣምር ወመንክር, singular nouns after ብዙኅ, so the singular verb is regular. ባቲ 'in/through her'. በአርአያ ወአምሳል 'in appearance and likeness' (አርአያ 'pattern, form'). ተኣምር 'sign, miracle' and መንክር 'wonder'. The ፨ closes the sentence.

Exodus 25:17–22). ምምሕፃነ I cannot place: it may be a form of ማሕፀን 'womb' (so Mary), or a 'cherishing place' from ሐፀነ 'embrace, nurse' (?). ምስትስራየ ኀጢአት 'a means of forgiveness of sin' appears twice as printed. አንቀጸ ሕይወት 'gate of life' (cf. sentences.i: For God loves the pure, for He is the dwelling of the pure, of those who enter His dwelling and cling to the holy Ark, and pray to Him with all their heart, and He hears them and saves them from the day of their distress and does their will;
sentences.n: The promise attached to the Ark: God dwells with those who come in purity. ንጹሐ 'the pure' (accusative, object of ያፈቅር). ማኅደር ለንጹሓን 'a dwelling for the pure ones' (cf. Psalm 50:15, which is 49:15 in the Greek numbering: calling on God in the day of trouble).

sentences.i: For He made a likeness of His throne for the holy Ark; and there are those who lead us in (?) while they liken themselves to us Christians, and the error does not leave them (?), which their father the Devil planted in them, and he says thus: 'It is right indeed that we bow within Zion, the Ark of the Law of God; she was first, and now this one too, her likeness and her fruit, the bearer of the Saviour, Mary: it is right that we bow to her;
sentences.n: A dense sentence; it sets the objection to be answered. አስተማሰላ: an ast- (causative-reflexive) stem of መሰለ 'be like', 3ms perfect, with the dative suffix -ላ 'for her', which ለቅድስት ታቦት repeats: 'he made a likeness (አምሳለ መንበሩ, accusative) of his throne for the holy Ark'. The other reading, 'he made the holy Ark a likeness of his throne', would take -ላ as 'her'; either way the Ark copies the heavenly throne (cf. Hebrews 8:5). ወቦእለ: 'and there are those who' (ቦ + እለ). ታበውኡነ: printed with the prefix ታ-, which with the plural ending -ኡ is 2mp ('you bring us in'; 3fs would have no -ኡ); a 3mp ያበውኡነ 'who bring us in' is what the grammar wants, and l and i follow that emendation, and the sense ('lead us in', perhaps into their error) is uncertain (?). ይትሜሰሉ ኪያነ ክርስቲያነ 'they resemble us, Christians' (ኪያነ the accusative 'us', ክርስቲያነ in apposition). 'Their father the Devil' echoes John 8:44. አሥረፀ 'caused to sprout, planted' (the causative of ሠረፀ). ወይብል 'and he says' (the objector, or the Devil). ኢየኀድጎሙ ስሕተት: the verb is masculine and ስሕተት feminine, so 'the error does not leave them' is a likely sense, not a certain one (?). ርቱዕሰ ንስግድ በውስተ ጽዮን ታቦተ ሕጉ: ጽዮን and ታቦተ ሕጉ stand in apposition (Zion is the Ark, as in ch. 1), and ሰገደ takes ለ- for the person bowed to, so there is no 'to the Ark' here. The objector's view as I read it: the Zion Ark, Mary (as the Ark's 'likeness and fruit', ወላዲተ መድኅን 'bearer of the Saviour') and the angels deserve worship, but not the arks of the saints; unit 17 onward answers it. ርቱዕሰ with -ሰ 'right indeed'; ቀዳሚኒ with -ኒ 'first indeed'.

sentences.n: The reason given for bowing to Mary: the Ark is blessed by her name. ተባረከ 'was blessed' (passive-reflexive), followed by ታቦተ in the accusative form where a nominative subject would be expected, a small oddity I keep as printed. ዚአሃ 'hers' (ዚአ + -ሃ), Mary's in this reading. The sense, in my reading: the Ark's blessing comes from what it prefigures, Mary.

sentences.n: The reply begins. ሊቀ ጳጳሳት 'chief of bishops' (construct) is the patriarch; ጌርሎስ is Cyril, I take of Alexandria (?); the spelling is as printed (I would expect ቄርሎስ, so it may be a variant or a slip). O Jew, blind of heart, do you see His mercy and His love for man when He speaks thus?
sentences.n: Matthew 12:49–50 / Mark 3:34–35: whoever does the will of the Father is Christ's brother, sister and mother. The source adds 'father' (see unit 18). መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of mankind' (a standard liturgical title: construct of መፍቀሪ + ሰብእ). ሰፍሐ እዴሁ 'spread out his hand' (Matthew 12:49 has him point to the disciples). ኢይፈልጥ ወኢይሌሊ: 'not distinguishing and not separating', male from female; ዕደ ወአንስተ 'men and women'. ዘሰምዐ ... ወገብረ 'who heard ... and did' (ዘ + 3ms perfect). ኦዕዉረ ልብ 'O blind of heart' (vocative, construct). ትሬኢኑ: 2ms imperfect of ርእየ + -ኑ (question). The 'blind Jew' is the book's standing polemical figure, addressed here as an imagined opponent; I translate it as it stands.

sentences.n: Source slips kept as printed: ወፈላሲ ፡ ያን, where ፈላሲ is singular 'stranger, pilgrim' and ያን is a stray ending; I read it as the plural ፈላስያን 'pilgrims, strangers' (Hebrews 11:13, the exiles of faith), and mark it (?). Because the text is cut by script from the source, I did not mend it. ወውእቱኒ ያፈቅሮሙ 'and he also loves them'. ዘተሐንጸ: ዘ + 3ms perfect passive of ሐነጸ, 'what was built'. መርጡል: the glossary has it uncertain; here 'tombs, that is ...' suggests Greek martyrion 'martyr's shrine, memorial' (?), a guess I hedge (the house entry says 'unidentified', so the gloss entry needs broadening). ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church'. ዘቀደሱ ጳጳሳት ታቦታተ 'what bishops consecrated: arks', presumably the consecrated tablets of Ethiopian churches (?), as in ch. 103. ኵሉ ቅዱስ 'all (is) holy'. The sentence runs long with no ፤ to cut at.

sentences.i: in purity, without defilement or stain (?), in humility and meekness, those who pray toward a consecrated ark, whether in the name of martyrs, or in the name of angels, or in the name of the righteous, or in the name of virgins, or in the name of holy women: when it has been consecrated, the Holy Spirit descends upon them and changes the wood so that it becomes spiritual;
sentences.n: Continues unit 22: how one prays. ዘእንበለ ርስሐት ወጥልቀት 'without impurity and ... ': ጥልቀት I take as 'stain, uncleanness' (?); the word is not secure. ይጼልዩ ኀበ 'they pray toward'. እመሂ ... ወእመሂ: 'whether ... or whether', repeated through five categories of the holy (martyrs, angels, the righteous, virgins, holy women; ቅዱሳት አንስት is the feminine plural with the broken plural አንስት). ተቀደሰ 'was consecrated' (passive of ቀደሰ). ይወርድ 'he/it descends' (3ms imperfect), 'upon them' (ላዕሌሆሙ, the plural arks or the worshippers). ይመይጦ ለዕፅ 'and he turns it, the wood' (ለ- marking the object), then ይኩን jussive 'that it be'. The consecration makes the wood 'spiritual' (መንፈሳዌ), which the two scriptural examples (units 24, 25) are brought to prove.

sentences.i: And as Joseph bowed to the tip (?) of Jacob's staff, while he (Jacob?) was before him, it did not tire him (?), but in his father's faith he bowed to the tip of his staff; and this too is what Moses wrote, a prophecy for the last days, so that we may know that arks are to be consecrated in the name of martyrs and righteous: for, while he saw it, he bowed to the tip of his staff. And again I tell you what is written concerning the pride of Pharaoh;
sentences.n: Genesis 47:31 as the Greek Old Testament has it and Hebrews 11:21 ('by faith Jacob ... worshipped, leaning on the top of his staff'). Here the one who bows is Joseph, and the staff is Jacob's; I keep that as printed. The argument: the staff is not God, yet reverence to it was no sin, so reverence to a hallowed object in a saint's name is not either. ከተማ 'tip, top' (?) as in unit 5. ኢያጻምዎ: negative 3ms imperfect of አጻመወ + -ዎ 'him', 'weary, trouble': 'it did not tire (or trouble) him' (?). Its subject is unexpressed (perhaps the bowing); ሀሎ 'was' is masculine, so I do not make the feminine staff its subject. ሰገደ ውስተ ከተማ: ሰገደ takes ለ- (as in the last clause); ውስተ is 'to, upon' here. በተአምኖ አቡሁ 'in the faith of his father' (ተአምኖ 'faith'). ዘጸሐፈ ሙሴ 'what Moses wrote' (Moses is taken as the author of Genesis). ከመ ናእምር 'so that we know'; ከመ ይትቄደሱ 'that they are consecrated' (3mp imperfect, passive). ይሬእዮ 'he sees it' (ርእየ, with -ኦ). The unit is about 45 words with no ፤ to cut at.

sentences.i: Moses made his rod, as God commanded him, a beast (serpent?) of the earth; and Pharaoh commanded the sorcerers to make likewise their rods, those of the men of Ḥäras (?); and they made their rods into three serpents, which moved by sorcery before Moses and Aaron and before Pharaoh and the great men of Egypt;
sentences.n: Exodus 7:8–12: the rod becomes a serpent and Pharaoh's magicians do the same. In Exodus it is Aaron who casts down the rod; the source puts it in Moses' hand (cf. Exodus 4:3). ገብረ በትሮ ረሰየ አርዌ ምድር: 'he made his rod, he set it, a beast of the earth': the second verb takes the predicate (see the glossary: አርዌ may be 'serpent'). መሠርያን 'sorcerers' (from ሥራይ 'sorcery'). ለሰብአ ሐራስ gives the owners of the rods after the suffix in አብትሪሆሙ: 'their rods, those of the men of ḥäras'. ሰብአ ሐራስ: I do not know ሐራስ; by context 'sorcerers, enchanters' (?) and I translate 'men of Ḥäras' to keep the lack of certainty. ፫ አክይስተ: 'three serpents', the number being the author's, not Exodus's. ይትሐወሳ: 3fp imperfect 'they moved, stirred' (agreeing with አክይስት, feminine plural). ዐበይተ ግብጽ 'great ones of Egypt'.

sentences.n: Exodus 7:12, Aaron's rod swallows the others. ወበልዐቶሙ (ለአብትረ መሠርያን repeats the object with ለ-): 3fs perfect of በልዐ 'swallow, eat' + -ሙ 'them', with the subject following (በትረ ሙሴ). ሕስዋነ ስም: 'falsehoods of name' or 'mere falsehoods', 'empty in name only' (?); I read ስም 'name' as 'only in name' and ሕስዋን as 'falsehoods, illusions' (?). ለአርአያ ዐይነ ሰብእ 'for the appearance (to) the eye of man' (አርአያ 'appearance'). The sorcerers' serpents are illusions made 'by sorcery' (በሥራይ), against the real change by the word of God.

sentences.i: As Paul said, "By faith the ancient fathers were saved"; he wished and set out exactly, name by name, from Adam and Noah and Abraham, and as far as Rahab the harlot, who received the spies (?). And you also, blind Jew: do you not understand in the law which you read, that is, which you trust, your Orit, while you cannot carry out (?) its commandments, and you are cursed by it?
sentences.n: Hebrews 11, the chapter on faith, which in the source runs through the fathers by name; Rahab the harlot received the men sent to look over Jericho (Hebrews 11:31; Joshua 2), so ሰብአ ዐይን would be 'spies' (?). Note that Hebrews 11 itself begins with Abel and Enoch; 'from Adam' is the author's summary. ድኅኑ: 3mp perfect 'were saved'. ፈቀደ ወአጠየቀ: 'he wished and set out exactly'. በበ ስሞሙ 'by their names' (distributive). ሰብአ ዐይን 'men of the eye' = spies (?). ኦሪት is the Orit, the Law/Torah, a word to learn. ኢትሌቡኑ: 'do you not understand?' (negative + -ኑ question), the verb taking a plural-looking shape; I keep it as printed. አስልጦ 'to carry out, to master' (a causative infinitive, perhaps of ሰልጠ 'have power'; 'carry out, fulfil' is a guess from the context (?)). ርጉም አንተ ባቲ 'accursed are you in it', a first echo of the curse of unit 31.

sentences.n: Galatians 3:10 quoting Deuteronomy 27:26: the curse on whoever does not keep all that is written in the Law. The number shifts (plural ኢዐቀቡ, singular ለይኩን) as printed. The point of the argument: under the Law as the Jew reads it, no one can escape the curse, which only faith (Mark 16:16 below) answers. ይብል 'it says'. ኵሎሙ ለእለ የሐውሩ ባቲ 'all of those who walk in it' (3mp imperfect of ሖረ). ለእመ 'if'. ዘጽሑፍ 'what is written' (passive participle). ርጉመ ለይኩን: accusative predicate 'cursed' + jussive ለይኩን 'let him be'. ይብለከ: 3ms 'says to you'.

sentences.i: But as for us, who have believed in Christ, the Son of God, the grace of God has chosen us, saying: "Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved."'
sentences.n: Mark 16:16 (belief and baptism bring salvation). The answer to the curse of units 30–31. ወለነሰ: 'and as for us' (ወ + ለ + -ነ + -ሰ). ለእለ አመነ: relative plural with a singular verb አመነ, a small mismatch noted in the glossary. ኀረየነ: 3ms perfect 'chose us'. ጸጋ እግዚኣብሔር 'grace of God' (construct), the subject. ዘአምነ ወተጠምቀ ይድኀን: 'whoever believed and was baptized, he will be saved' (ተጠምቀ, passive 'was baptized'). The six ፨ at the end close the part as printed, and Cyril's speech, begun in unit 17, ends here.

glossary.ሀሎ: ሀሎ — be, exist (3ms perfect, present sense 'is') · existed (3ms perfect, past sense: 'before the sun his name existed')
glossary.ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')
glossary.ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
glossary.ለመሠርያን: መሠርይ — to the sorcerers (ለ- + plural መሠርያን)
glossary.ለሙሴ: ሙሴ — to Moses (ለ- + proper name) · ለ- marking the object after an anticipating suffix (ሐመይዎ ለሙሴ 'they slandered Moses') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (የውሃቶ ለሙሴ 'the meekness of Moses')
glossary.ለሰብአ: ሰብእ — the men of (ለ- + noun, construct 'men-of'; the ለ- marks the object, doubling the suffix on the verb)
glossary.ለቅድስት: ቅዱስ — for the holy (ለ- + adjective, fem. sg. ቅድስት)
glossary.ለበትረ: በትር — the rod of (ለ- marking the object, doubling the suffix of the verb, + noun, construct)
glossary.ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of') · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (ወንሥኣ ለታቦተ ሕጉ 'and take the Ark of his law')
glossary.ለታቦት: ታቦት — of the ark (ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix + noun)
glossary.ለንጹሓን: ንጹሕ — of the pure ones (ለ- naming the owner after a suffix + plural ንጹሓን)
glossary.ለኖኅ: ኖኅ — to Noah (ለ- + proper name; object-marking, doubling the suffix of አድኀኖ)
glossary.ለአርአያ: አርአያ — to/for the appearance, form of (ለ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ለአብርሃም: አብርሃም — to Abraham (ለ- + proper name) · object-marking ለ- doubling the suffix of አፍለሶ (አፍለሶ እግዚኣብሔር ለአብርሃም 'God moved Abraham') · ለ- marking the owner (እኁሁ ለአብርሃም 'his brother, Abraham's')
glossary.ለአብትረ: በትር — the rods of (ለ- marking the object, doubling the suffix of the verb, + plural አብትር, construct)
glossary.ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (ስሕተቱ ለአዳም 'Adam's error') and in apposition (ላዕሌሁ ለአዳም 'upon him, upon Adam')
glossary.ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (አዝማዲሆሙ ለእለ ኀልቁ 'the kinsmen of those who perished')
glossary.ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
glossary.ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
glossary.ለከተማ: ከተማ — to the tip, top (?) (ለ- + noun; ሰገደ ለከተማ 'he bowed to the tip') (?)
glossary.ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
glossary.ለዕፅ: ዕፅ — the wood (ለ- object-marking + noun; ወይመይጦ ለዕፅ 'and he changes the wood')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
glossary.ለይኩን: ኮነ — let it be (ለ- jussive particle + 3ms jussive ይኩን, k-w-n)
glossary.ለደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — for the last, latter (ለ- + adjective)
glossary.ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
glossary.ለፈርዖን: ፈርዖን — Pharaoh (proper name; ለ- restating the object)
glossary.ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
glossary.ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
glossary.ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
glossary.ሐራስ: ሐራስ — unidentified (?) (ሰብአ ሐራስ 'men of ḥäras'; perhaps a people or class, or related to ሐራሲ 'plowman'; left unguessed) (?)
glossary.ሕስዋነ: ሕስው — false, a falsehood (?) (adjective or noun, plural ሕስዋን; እሙንቱ ሕስዋነ ስም 'they were falsehoods in name only') (?)
glossary.ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
glossary.መርሶ: መርሶ — harbour, anchorage (noun; መርሶ መድኀኒት 'harbour of salvation')
glossary.መርጡል: መርጡል — uncertain, unidentified; an epithet of the tent (perhaps 'meeting') · of the martyrs' tombs, 'martyrium, shrine' (?) (መቃብሪሆሙ ዘውእቱ መርጡል 'their tombs, that is the martyria'; perhaps a loan from Greek μαρτύριον) (?)
glossary.መቃብሪሆሙ: መቃብር — their tombs, graves (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; stem መቃብሪ- before a suffix)
glossary.መንፈሳዌ: መንፈሳዊ — spiritual (adjective; accusative/predicate form after ይኩን)
glossary.መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour) · construct 'salvation of' (መድኀኒተ ደቂቅከ 'the salvation of your sons') · 'of the saviour' before a relative clause (መድኀኒተ ዘተፈነወ 'of the saviour who was sent') · accusative object, 'salvation' (ወሀበ እግዚኣብሔር መድኀኒተ 'God gave salvation'; ረሰየ ሎቱ መድኀኒተ 'he made salvation for him') · second accusative after ረሰየ/ረሰያ, 'a saviour' (ረሰያ ለታቦት መድኀኒተ 'He made the Ark a saviour')
glossary.መጠዉ: መጠወ — they gave over, delivered (3mp perfect, G, m-ṭ-w)
glossary.መጽአ: መጽአ — he/it came (3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.መፍቀሬ: መፍቀሪ — lover of (noun, construct, from ፈቀረ 'love')
glossary.ሜጣ: መየጠ — he turned her, changed her (3ms perfect, G, + -ኣ '3fs her'; m-y-ṭ; በከመ ሜጣ ለበትረ ሙሴ 'as He turned the rod of Moses')
glossary.ምሕረቶ: ምሕረት — his mercy (noun, fem., accusative + -ኦ '3ms his')
glossary.ምምሕፃነ: ምምሕፃን — womb, place of nurture (?) (noun, accusative; perhaps from ሐፀነ 'carry in the arms, nurse'; meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ምሥሃል: ምሥሃል — mercy-seat, place of mercy (noun; perhaps from ሣህል 'mercy', root not checked) (?)
glossary.ምረራ: ምረር — bitterness (noun, construct 'bitterness of'; ምረራ ለሞት 'the bitterness of death') (?)
glossary.ምስትስራየ: ምስትስርይ — means of forgiveness (noun, construct/accusative; ምስትስራየ ኀጢአት 'means of forgiveness of sin')
glossary.ምስካይ: ምስካይ — refuge, shelter (?) (noun; uncertain lexical call (?))
glossary.ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
glossary.ረሰየ: ረሰየ — set, appoint, make (3ms perfect, G, r-s-y)
glossary.ረሰያ: ረሰየ — he made her (3ms perfect, G, r-s-y + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate) · predicate before a subjunctive, 'it is right that' (ርቱዕ ንስግድ 'it is right that we bow')
glossary.ርቱዕሰ: ርቱዕ — right indeed (adjective, predicate + enclitic -ሰ 'indeed, for one thing')
glossary.ርጉመ: ርጉም — cursed (passive participle of ረገመ; accusative predicate)
glossary.ሰማዕት: ሰማዕት — martyr, witness (noun; here collective or plural 'martyrs')
glossary.ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ሰገደ: ሰገደ — he bowed down (3ms perfect, G, s-g-d; ሰገደ ውስተ/ለ- 'bowed to')
glossary.ሳቤቅ: ሳቤቅ — Sabek (proper name, qualifying ዕፀ 'tree of'; uncertain) (?)
glossary.ስመዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear, then! (2mp imperative, G, s-m-ʿ, + enclitic -ኒ 'then, now')
glossary.ቀደምት: ቀዳማይ — former, ancient, first (adjective, plural ቀደምት, agreeing with አበዊነ 'our fathers') (?)
glossary.ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began') · noun 'the first, the beginning' (በእንተ ቀዳሚ 'concerning the Beginning'; ቀዳሚ ትርጓሜሁ ክርስቶስ 'the beginning, its interpretation is Christ')
glossary.ቀዳሚኒ: ቀዳሚ — first indeed, first of all (adjective + enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ቅዱሳት: ቅዱስ — holy (feminine plural ቅዱሳት; ቅዱሳት አንስት 'holy women')
glossary.ቅድሜሁ: ቅድመ — before him (preposition ቅድመ in its form ቅድሜ- + -hu 'him')
glossary.በሥራይ: ሥራይ — by sorcery (በ- + noun 'sorcery, magic, charm')
glossary.በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
glossary.በስሞሙ: ስም — in their names (በ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
glossary.በቅድሜሃ: ቅድሜ — before her (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- 'front' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.በቅድስት: ቅዱስ — to the holy (በ- + feminine ቅድስት of ቅዱስ; agreeing with ታቦት)
glossary.በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
glossary.በተአምኖ: ተአምኖ — in the faith of (በ- + verbal noun, construct; 'faith, belief')
glossary.በታቦት: ታቦት — by an ark, in an ark (በ- + noun)
glossary.በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
glossary.በትሩ: በትር — his rod (በትር + -ሁ '3ms his', the suffix showing as -u on the final ር)
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
glossary.በአምሳሊሃ: አምሳል — in her likeness (በ- + noun, stem አምሳሊ- before a suffix, + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.በአርአያ: አርአያ — after the pattern of, in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — for his sake (በእንተ + -hu, variant በእንቲአሁ)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — in, by Christ (በ- + proper name)
glossary.በዕፀ: ዕፅ — by the wood of (በ- + noun, construct state)
glossary.በዕፅ: ዕፅ — with wood (በ- + ዕፅ 'wood, tree', noun)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በ፫: ፫ — with three (በ- + numeral 3), spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three' (numeral; counted number)
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
glossary.ተሰምየት: ተሰምየ — she was called, named (3fs perfect, Gt passive of ሰምየ, s-m-y)
glossary.ተቀደሰ: ተቀደሰ — he/it was made holy, was hallowed (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀደሰ)
glossary.ተባረከ: ባረከ — he was blessed (3ms perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ, b-r-k)
glossary.ተእኅዘ: ተአኀዘ — it was seized, caught (3ms perfect, Gt passive of አኀዘ 'seize', ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ተወክፈቶሙ: ተወክፈ — she received them (3fs perfect, Gt, + -ሙ 'them'; w-k-f)
glossary.ታበውኡነ: አብአ — they bring us in, lead us in (?) (ቦእለ ታበውኡነ; printed with the 2mp prefix ታ- + -ኡ, expected 3mp ያበውኡነ; imperfect of the causative of ቦአ, + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታቦትሰ: ታቦት — ark (noun) + enclitic -ሰ marking contrast, 'as for the Ark'
glossary.ትሬኢኑ: ርእየ — do you see? (2ms imperfect, G, + interrogative -ኑ; r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ትእዛዛቲሃ: ትእዛዝ — its commandments (plural ትእዛዛት + -ሃ '3fs its, her')
glossary.ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
glossary.ኀረየነ: ኀረየ — he chose us (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-r-y + -ነ '1cp us'; after እለ 'whom')
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him') · 'with him, in his hand' expressing possession or disposal (እስመ ኀቤሁ ክብር ወኀሳር 'for with him are glory and loss')
glossary.ኀጢአት: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, fem.; here genitive after construct ርስሐተ 'defilement of sin') · after ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ኀጢአት 'without sin') · predicate, 'are sin' (ምግባሮሙ ኀጢአት)
glossary.ነዮሙ: ናሁ — behold them (presentative with -ሙ '3mp them'; ነዮሙ አቡከ 'behold, your father')
glossary.ናእምር: አእመረ — we know, that we may know (1cp subjunctive, root ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ንሕነኒ: ንሕነ — we also, we for our part (1cp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ንስግድ: ሰገደ — we worship, let us worship (1cp subjunctive/imperfect, s-g-d) · 'we bow, let us bow down' (ሰገደ takes ለ- for the one bowed to), subjunctive after ርቱዕ (ርቱዕ ንስግድ ላቲ 'it is right that we bow to her')
glossary.ንብሎሙ: ብህለ — we say to them (1cp imperfect, G, defective verb b-h-l, + -ሙ 'to them')
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
glossary.አምሳለ: አምሳል — likeness, image (construct 'likeness of') · accusative 'likenesses, types' after ብዙኀ 'many' (ብዙኀ አምሳለ 'many likenesses')
glossary.አምሳሊሃኒ: አምሳል — her likeness also (noun, stem አምሳሊ- + -ሃ '3fs her' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.አሥረፀ: አሥረፀ — he planted, caused to sprout (3ms perfect, causative of ሠረፀ 'sprout', ś-r-ḍ)
glossary.አርዌ: አርዌ — wild beast; perhaps also 'serpent' (?) (noun, singular, construct 'beast of'; plural አራዊት)
glossary.አስልጦ: አስልጠ — to carry out, fulfil (?) (ኢትክል አስልጦ ትእዛዛቲሃ 'you cannot carry out its commandments'; root and form uncertain) (?)
glossary.አስተማሰላ: አስተማሰለ — he made a likeness of, fashioned (a likeness) for her (3ms perfect, causative-reflexive of መሰለ 'be like', m-s-l, + -ኣ '3fs her'; አምሳለ መንበሩ አስተማሰላ 'he made a likeness of his throne for her') (?)
glossary.አስትቶ: አስትቶ — wavering, doubt (?) (ዘእንበለ አስትቶ 'without wavering'; form and root uncertain) (?)
glossary.አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
glossary.አቡየኒ: አብ — my father also (noun + -የ '1s my' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.አብትረ: በትር — rods (plural አብትር, accusative after the number 'twelve')
glossary.አንበራ: አንበረ — he set her, placed her (3ms perfect, causative, + -ኣ '3fs her'; n-b-r)
glossary.አክይስተ: ከይሲ — serpent, snake (noun; plural አክይስት, accusative አክይስተ)
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አድኀኖ: አድኀነ — he saved him (3ms perfect, causative a-stem of ድኅነ + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢትሌቡኑ: ለበወ — do you not understand? (ኢ- + imperfect ትሌቡ, plural-looking though addressed to one, + interrogative -ኑ; l-b-w 'understand, perceive'; the stem form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ኢዐቀቡ: ዐቀበ — they did not keep (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ኢያጻምዎ: አጽመወ — it does not tire him (?) (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸመወ 'be weary', + -ዎ 'him'; the form and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ኢይፈልጥ: ፈለጠ — he does not distinguish, make a difference (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, f-l-ṭ)
glossary.ኢፈለጠ: ፈለጠ — he did not distinguish (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-l-ṭ)
glossary.እመሂ: እመ — whether, if (conjunction + enclitic -ሂ; እመሂ ... ወእመሂ 'whether ... or whether')
glossary.እምሀገረ: ሀገር — from the city of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — from the first, from the beginning (እም- + adj. as noun)
glossary.እምትካት: ትካት — from the foundation, from of old (?) (እም- 'from' + ትካት 'establishment', cf. ዘትካት in ch. 30; sense uncertain) (?) · 'in turn, in exchange' (?) after መድኀኒተ ረሰያ/ረሰየ 'made a salvation' (መድኀኒተ እምትካት 'a salvation in turn'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.እምዕለተ: ዕለት — from the day of (እም- + noun fem., construct)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እከሥት: ከሠተ — I will reveal, explain (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G)
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.ኦዕዉረ: ዕዉር — O blind one (ኦ vocative + adjective; accusative before ልብ 'blind of heart')
glossary.ኦዕዉር: ዕዉር — O blind one (ኦ vocative + adjective)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ከተማ: ከተማ — tip, top (?) (noun; the usual sense 'city', here the 'top' of a staff) (?)
glossary.ክርስቲያነ: ክርስቲያን — Christian, Christians (noun; accusative, collective, in apposition to ኪያነ 'us')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?) · 'came to be' with a noun predicate/subject (በዕፅ ኮነ መድኀኒቱ ለአዳም 'through wood came Adam's salvation'; ኮነ ቀዳሚ ስሕተቱ 'came his first error'); ኮነት 'she became' of the rod (ወኮነት ዘነፍስ 'and it became living')
glossary.ኰሳኵሰ: ኰሳኵሰ — peeled, stripped (?) (unidentified word, perhaps from a quadriliteral ኰሰኰሰ; accusative or adverb; meaning from context only) (?)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55) · 'all those' as antecedent of the relative እለ (እምነ ኵሎሙ እለ ፈጠረ 'above (?) all those whom he created')
glossary.ወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — giver of (agent noun of ወሀበ 'give', construct ወሃቤ; the initial ወ is a root letter, not 'and', as in ወወሃቤ ch. 24; ወሃቤ ሲሳይ 'giver of food')
glossary.ወለሙሴኒ: ሙሴ — and to Moses also (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለሚካኤል: ሚካኤል — and to Michael (ወ- + ለ- + proper name, the archangel)
glossary.ወለነሰ: ለ — and as for us (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወለገብርኤል: ገብርኤል — and to Gabriel (ወ- + ለ- + proper name, the archangel)
glossary.ወላዲተ: ወላዲት — bearer of, mother of (noun, fem., construct; active participle of ወለደ; ወላዲተ አምላክ 'Mother of God')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወርጉም: ርጉም — and cursed (ወ- + passive participle, adjective)
glossary.ወሰፍሐ: ሰፍሐ — and he spread out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወበልዐቶሙ: በልዐ — and she swallowed them (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, + -ሙ 'them'; b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወበቅድመ: ቅድመ — and before (ወ- + በ- + preposition, with a following construct)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበከተማ: ከተማ — and at the tip, top (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun; the usual sense 'city', here the 'top' of a staff) (?)
glossary.ወበዕፅ: ዕፅ — and through wood (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወቦእለ: ቦ — and there are those who (ወ- + ቦ 'there is' + relative እለ, run together)
glossary.ወተሰምየት: ተሰምየ — and she was called (ወ- + 3fs perfect, Gt passive of ሰምየ, s-m-y)
glossary.ወተናገሮ: ተናገረ — and he spoke with him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem, n-g-r; + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወተገብረ: ተገብረ — and it was done (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt passive, g-b-r)
glossary.ወተጠምቀ: ተጠምቀ — and he was baptized (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt passive of ጠመቀ 'baptize, dip', ṭ-m-q)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወነገረ: ነገር — and the affairs of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word, matter of'; the spelling is also that of a verb 'and he said') (?)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአብዐሎ: አብዐለ — and he made him rich, enriched him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of the root b-ʿ-l 'be rich', + -ኦ 'him'; the G verb not checked) (?)
glossary.ወአኀውየ: እኁ — and my brothers (ወ- + plural አኀው + -የ '1s my')
glossary.ወአንስተ: ብእሲት — and women (ወ- + broken plural አንስት, accusative)
glossary.ወአንተኒ: አንተ — and you also (ወ- 'and' + 2ms independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — and he answered them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative-type stem + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአዘዞሙ: አዘዘ — and he commanded them (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወአድኀኖ: አድኀነ — and he saved him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, + -ኦ 'him'; d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ወአጠየቀ: አጠየቀ — and he set out exactly, investigated (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ወአፍርሀቶ: አፍርሀ — and she frightened him (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of ፈርሀ 'fear', + -ኦ 'him'; f-r-h)
glossary.ወአፍቀርዎ: አፍቀረ — and they loved him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative-stem, + -ዎ 'him'; f-q-r)
glossary.ወአፍቅሮቶ: አፍቅሮት — and his love (ወ- + verbal noun + -ኦ '3ms his'; the object of the love follows, ሰብአ 'for man')
glossary.ወኢሌለየ: ሌለየ — and he did not separate (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, l-y-y)
glossary.ወኢየኀድጎሙ: ኀደገ — and does not leave them (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ሙ 'them'; ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ወኢያርኵሱ: አርኰሰ — and that they not defile (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative of ረኰሰ 'be unclean', r-k-ʷ-s)
glossary.ወኢይሌሊ: ሌለየ — and does not separate, set apart (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect of ሌለየ, l-y-y)
glossary.ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወእምየ: እም — and my mother (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወእምየኒ: እም — and my mother also (ወ- + noun + -የ '1s my' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወእኅትየኒ: እኅት — and my sister also (ወ- + noun + -የ '1s my' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — and the great ones, great men (ወ- + adjective, plural ዐበይት, accusative)
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዘሰ: ዘ — and whoever, indeed (ወ- + relative ዘ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘሰአለ: ሰአለ — and whoever asked (ወ- + relative ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, s-ʾ-l)
glossary.ወዘቀደሱ: ቀደሰ — and what they consecrated (ወ- + relative ዘ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-d-s)
glossary.ወዘተሐንጸ: ተሐንጸ — and what was built (ወ- + relative ዘ- + 3ms perfect, Gt passive of ሐነጸ 'build', ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዝኒ: ዝ — and this also (ወ- + demonstrative ዝ 'this' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወየውሃት: የውሃት — and meekness, gentleness (ወ- + የውሃት, noun)
glossary.ወያሰፍኖ: አሰፈነ — and he provides for him (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative, + -ኦ 'him'; root and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወያድኅኖሙ: አድኀነ — and he saves them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወያጸድቆ: አጽደቀ — and he declares him righteous, justifies him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸድቀ, + -ኦ 'him'; ṣ-d-q)
glossary.ወይመይጦ: መየጠ — and he turns it, changes it (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'it'; m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ወይሰምዖሙ: ሰምዐ — and he hears them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ሙ 'them'; s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይብል: ብህለ — and he says (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ወይትአኀዙ: ተአኀዘ — and they cling, hold fast (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, Gt of አኀዘ 'seize', ʾ-ḫ-z; ተአኅዘ በ- 'cling to')
glossary.ወይገብር: ገብረ — and he does, makes (ወ- + 3m sg imperfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ወይጼልዩ: ጸለየ — and they pray (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ወደየ: ወደየ — he put, placed (3ms perfect, G, w-d-y); ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r) · also 'and they did' (ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ 'and they did for us what is by his law')
glossary.ወጥልቀት: ጥልቀት — and stain, blemish (?) (ወ- + noun; meaning from context, ዘእንበለ ርስሐት ወጥልቀት 'without defilement and stain') (?)
glossary.ወጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — and exactly, accurately (ወ- + adjective, adverbial accusative)
glossary.ወፈላሲ: ፈላሲ — and pilgrim, stranger (?) (ወ- + noun; the plural ending follows apart, see ያን) (?)
glossary.ወፍሬሃኒ: ፍሬ — and her fruit also (ወ- + noun + -ሃ '3fs her' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ው: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms pronoun; ው is the first part of ውእቱ, printed apart from እቱ, sic)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዐይነ: ዐይን — eye (noun, construct/accusative; ዐይነ ሰብእ 'the eyes of men')
glossary.ዕልዋን: ዕሉው — perverse, wicked (?) (adjective used as a noun, plural ዕልዋን 'the perverse'; ወነገረ ዕልዋን 'and the matter of the perverse') (?)
glossary.ዕደ: ዕድ — men (?) (noun; ዕደ ወአንስተ 'men and women'; collective or plural form, the singular uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘሰምዐ: ሰምዐ — what he heard (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G) · who heard, the one who heard (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘተቀደሰ: ተቀደሰ — which was sanctified, made holy (ዘ + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀደሰ)
glossary.ዘተገብረ: ተገብረ — which was done (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ዘታነብብ: አነበበ — which you read (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect, Q-stem, ʾ-n-b-b)
glossary.ዘትትአመን: ተአመነ — which you believe, trust (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect, Gt, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ዘነፍስ: ነፍስ — that of soul, i.e. living (?) (ዘ- 'of' + noun; the pair with ይብስት 'dry' is my reading) (?)
glossary.ዘአምነ: አምነ — who believed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame')

glossary.ዘይሜግቦ: መገበ — who feeds him (?) (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, + -ኦ 'him'; m-g-b; the ሜ- spelling as in ይሜህሮሙ) (?)
glossary.ዘይረክቦ: ረከበ — which befalls it, finds it (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'it'; r-k-b)
glossary.ዘጸሐፈ: ጸሐፈ — which he wrote (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-ḥ-f)
glossary.ዘጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — what is written (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽሑፍ)
glossary.ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.የኀሡከ: ኀሠሠ — they seek you (3mp imperfect, G, + -ከ '2ms you'; ḫ-ś-ś)
glossary.የዐቅቡ: ዐቀበ — who keep (3mp imperfect, G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ያን: ፈላሲ — -ያን, the plural ending of ፈላሲ, printed apart from it (ፈላሲ ያን for ፈላስያን 'pilgrims'; sic) (?)
glossary.ያአምሩ: አእመረ — they know (3mp imperfect, ʿ-m-r, as ናእምር)
glossary.ያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — he loves (3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ያፈቅርዎ: አፍቀረ — they love him (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ያፈቅሮሙ: አፍቀረ — he loves them (3ms imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይመውእ: መውአ — he overcomes, defeats (3ms imperfect, m-w-ʾ)
glossary.ይሜህሮሙ: መሀረ — he teaches them (3ms imperfect, G, + -ሙ 'them'; m-h-r)
glossary.ይሬእዮ: ርእየ — he sees it (3ms imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'it'; r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ይሰምዖ: ሰምዐ — he hears him (3ms imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'him'; s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ይስአልዎ: ሰአለ — that they ask him (3mp subjunctive, G, + -ዎ 'him'; s-ʾ-l)
glossary.ይበውኡ: ቦአ — they enter (3mp imperfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብለከ: ብህለ — he/it says to you (3ms imperfect, G, defective verb b-h-l, + -ከ 'to you')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትሐወሳ: ተሐወሰ — they move, stir (3fp imperfect, Gt of ሐወሰ 'go about', ḥ-w-s)
glossary.ይትሜሰሉ: ተመሰለ — they liken themselves, resemble (3mp imperfect, Gt, m-s-l)
glossary.ይትቀነይ: ተቀንየ — he serves (3ms imperfect, Gt of ቀነየ, q-n-y; lemma the 3ms perfect)
glossary.ይትቄደሱ: ተቀደሰ — that they be consecrated (3mp subjunctive, Gt passive, q-d-s)
glossary.ይትአመን: ተአመነ — he believes (3ms imperfect, Gt, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይነሥኣ: ነሥአ — he takes her (3ms imperfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ይድኀን: ድኅነ — he will be saved (3ms imperfect, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ድኅኑ: ድኅነ — they were saved (3mp perfect, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant') · they made (3mp perfect of ገብረ, G, g-b-r; ገብሩ አህጉረ 'they made cities')
glossary.ጌርሎስ: ጌርሎስ — Cyril (proper name; the patriarch Cyril)
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct) · Egypt as goal of a journey, accusative without a preposition (ርደተ አብርሃም ግብጽ 'descent of Abraham to Egypt') · the Egyptians (ርእይዎሙ ግብጽ 'the Egyptians saw them')
glossary.ጸሎት: ጸሎት — prayer (noun; ቤተ ጸሎት 'house of prayer')
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈጠረ: ፈጠረ — he created (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r)
glossary.ፈጣሪ: ፈጣሪ — creator, maker (noun; participle of ፈጠረ)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፻፬: ፻፬ — 104, spoken ምእት ወአርባዕቱ (məʾət wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'one hundred and four' (numeral; chapter number)
